visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of yellow, thick ramen noodles being lifted high by white plastic chopsticks. The noodles are heavily coated in a rich, viscous orange-brown curry sauce. Chunks of what appear to be mock meat and red carrots are visible in the bowl against a grey background. (2) A top-down close-up of a bowl of Thai-style spicy and sour soup. The broth is a deep reddish-orange with visible oil droplets, filled with mushrooms, white corn, and thin noodles. Steam is faintly visible. (3) Outdoor street view of the restaurant's entrance. A prominent yellow rectangular sign with the red text '黃師姐素食' hangs above the stall. Several motorbikes are parked in front, and a person in a pink shirt is visible working inside. (4) Inside the food stall, a glass display case holds various vegetarian ingredients including different types of tofu, veggie steaks, and balls. A hand in a blue sleeve is seen reaching for items. (5) On a stainless steel table, a hand places a bowl of curry noodles next to the Thai soup. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from the open storefront. (6) Close-up of the curry noodles being stirred; the sauce has a glossy texture and adheres to the wavy noodles. Broccoli florets are seen on the side. (7) Close-up of braised noodles in a lighter brown clear broth with corn on the cob, carrots, and white radishes. A stainless steel spoon adds bright red chili oil to the mix. (8) A hand using metal tongs picks up a piece of brown braised tofu and places it on a white plate alongside other veggie meats and a veggie ball. (9) A plate of freshly cut braised snacks is shown, topped with thin strips of ginger. A side dish of bright green peppers is placed next to it. (10) An interior shot of the dining area showing empty square stainless steel tables and blue plastic stools on a white tiled floor. A clock on the wall shows the time. (11) Final outdoor shot of the restaurant exterior at a slightly different angle, with the yellow sign visible against a cloudy sky.
